hypothesis: vtable-based schema evolution for the binary .atlas format (P2)
blocking_question: does vtable-indirected field access add anything the wire contract does not provide, or do only the append-only/deprecate-never-remove rule and a flatc --conform-style conformance checker remain?

measurement.vtables: nothing new: the contract's length-delimited tag-length-value records already give absent-optional-field-means-default, which is what a vtable bounds check provides
measurement.evolution_gap: the contract promises 'schema versions and compatibility rules' for new fields, but G68 derives schema_id from the full definition and the reader accepts only the current one -- appending an optional field would orphan every earlier container, and nothing distinguished a compatible change from a breaking one or stopped a breaking edit to SECTIONS from landing
measurement.donor_mechanism: src/idl_parser.cpp Parser::ConformTo: a surviving field keeps offset (id), default and type; a rename keeps offset and type; deletion is refused; enum values never change
measurement.trigger: the census recorded the conformance checker as the sole ABSORB_LATER item, triggered by the first .atlas section writer -- which exists since G64

absorbed_mechanism.name: schema-evolution-conformance
absorbed_mechanism.native_owner: core::atlas::schema::{conforms, recorded_generations, accepted_schema_ids, HISTORY} + core/src/atlas/schema_history.rs; the reader checks accepted identities
absorbed_mechanism.rules: section name and dependencies kept; no record kind removed; fields keep tag and wire type, are never removed and never become required; added fields optional; same-tag same-wire renames conform
absorbed_mechanism.verification: latest recorded generation must equal SECTIONS; every recorded generation must conform; each rule has a breaking and a compatible case; a container stamped by a conforming older identity is read with its history and refused without; mutation battery 9/9 killed after closing two real test gaps

REFERENCE_ONLY: vtables and offset-indirected access, flexbuffers, reflection, flatc code generation

extinction.test_dependency: none (no code or test references the checkout; not a DC1 Cargo donor)
